title: 第23章 这一次孤全要第24章 龙珠化日祖龙的选择
slug: 重生商纣开局怒怼圣人女娲
content_zh:
第23章这一次，孤！全！要！就在朝歌中流言四起时，
身在人皇宫内的帝辛，整个人都仿佛化成一团正在熊熊燃烧的怒火！
他想不到昊天竟然如此疯狂，不顾后果地遮天，用洪荒亿万万人族的命来威胁自己，就是为了要让自己臣服于天界，
想到这，
帝辛冷着脸，咬着牙根一字一顿道：“呵呵，昊天真是打的好算盘啊！”
就在这时，这才听到系统那姗姗来迟的声音——
“叮：检测到昊天不顾洪荒亿万万生灵，违背天地运转规则，强行遮天，对人皇施压，宿主选择如下……”
“选择一：借力打力，下达人皇诏，号召洪荒亿万万人族，同时呼唤人教教主太上老君，让太上老君教训昊天！选择奖励：后天八卦，修为十万年！”
“选择二：以武乱禁，弹指破天，凝人道之力于人皇玺中，击碎天庭星斗宫，令天地自行运转，可使光明重现洪荒！选择奖励：开天剑符，修为十万年！”
“选择三：为天地立规，为众生立命，以人皇玺配合山河图，凝洪荒生灵怒火，一剑开天，彻底劈断天庭和洪荒大陆的联系，绝地天通！选择奖励：人道不灭体，修为十万年！”
三个选择？
难怪系统姗姗来迟，原来是破例出了第三个选项。
显然，
系统也怒了！
但这时，帝辛依旧闭着眼，自言自语道：“昊天如此欺人，任何一个选项都不足以平息孤心中的怒火，这一次，孤！全！要！”
帝辛说着，
眼中忽然闪过一抹寒光，冰冷的杀意涌动间，甚至连刚刚走上来的闻仲，都被惊得一连退后了数步。
这一次，
他彻底怒了！
因为昊天这个做法，完全突破了帝辛的底线！

哪怕他认为，自己已经完美地适应了人皇的身份、人皇的肚量，这时也被气得浑身颤抖！
就在这时——
“叮：恭喜宿主做出第四种选择，一次把昊天打痛、打怕！选择奖励：人皇殿，混沌钟碎片（14），修为十万年起步（每多惊动一位圣人，修为奖励增加十万年！），奖励在事后进行统一发放！”
嗯？
有第四种选择吗？
听到脑海中的声音后，帝辛先是一愣，之后又仔细地看了看，
哦，
还真有，难道是刚刚没注意吗？
不过这个修为奖励就有些有意思了，每多惊动一位圣人，就能多奖励十万年的修为！
可现在当务之急，是要先让洪荒恢复光明才对！
就在这时，
闻仲急匆匆地走了上来，心急如焚道：“大王，现在天帝遮天，威逼大王，本来这件事可以让女娲娘娘出面，可现在女娲娘娘估计不会理会啊！”
商容也无比焦急地说道：“是啊大王，现在还是八百诸侯觐见大王的关键时候，而且朝歌内外出现了无数谣言，都在痛斥大王无德，要是不解决遮天之事，迟则生变！”
比干也急忙说道：“大王，不如您先安抚八百诸侯，我与首相等外出平息民怨如何？！”
content_en:
Chapter 23 This time, alone! Complete! want! Just when rumors were spreading in Chaoge,
Di Xin, who was in the Human Imperial Palace, seemed to have turned into a ball of burning anger!
He didn't expect that Haotian would be so crazy, covering the sky regardless of the consequences, threatening himself with the lives of hundreds of millions of people in the prehistoric era, just to make himself surrender to the heaven.
Thinking of this,
Di Xin had a cold face, gritted his teeth and said word by word: "Haha, Haotian really made a good plan!"
Just then, I heard the belated voice of the system——
"Ding: It has been detected that Haotian ignores the billions of living beings in the prehistoric times, violates the rules of the operation of heaven and earth, forcibly covers the sky, and puts pressure on the Human Emperor. The host selection is as follows..."
"Choice 1: Leverage your strength and issue an edict from the Human Emperor, calling on hundreds of millions of people in the prehistoric times. At the same time, you call upon the leader of the Human Sect, Taishang Laojun, and ask Taishang Laojun to teach Haotian a lesson! Choose the reward: acquired gossip, and cultivate for 100,000 years!"
"Choice 2: Use force to break the ban, break the sky with a snap of your finger, condense the power of humanity into the Human Emperor's Seal, smash the Starry Palace in Heaven, make the heaven and earth rotate on their own, and bring light back to the prehistoric times! Choice reward: Opening Heaven Sword Talisman, cultivation for 100,000 years!"
"Choice Three: Establish rules for the heaven and earth, establish destiny for all living beings, use the Human Emperor's Seal to match the mountain and river map, condense the anger of the primitive creatures, open the sky with one sword, completely sever the connection between the heaven and the primitive continent, the ultimate heavenly power! Choice reward: Indestructible human body, cultivation for 100,000 years!"
Three options?
No wonder the system was delayed. It turned out that the third option was made as an exception.
Obviously,
The system is also angry!
But at this time, Di Xin still closed his eyes and muttered to himself: "Haotian is so deceptive. No option is enough to calm the anger in Gu's heart. This time, Gu! Quan! Want it!"
Di Xin said,
A cold light suddenly flashed in his eyes, and the cold murderous intent surged. Even Wen Zhong, who had just walked up, was so frightened that he took a few steps back.
This time,
He was completely angry!
Because Haotian's approach completely broke through Di Xin's bottom line!
Even though he thought that he had perfectly adapted to the Human Emperor's status and size, he was so angry that he was shaking all over!
Just then——
"Ding: Congratulations to the host for making the fourth choice, beating Haotian in pain and fear all at once! Choice reward: Palace of the Human Emperor, Chaos Bell Fragments (14), starting with a cultivation level of 100,000 years (for each additional saint disturbed, the cultivation reward will increase by 100,000 years!), and the rewards will be distributed uniformly afterwards!"
Huh?
Is there a fourth option?
After hearing the voice in his head, Di Xin was stunned for a moment, then looked at it carefully.
Oh,
It really does exist. Did you not pay attention just now?
However, this cultivation reward is a bit interesting. Every time one more saint is alerted, an additional hundred thousand years of cultivation will be rewarded!
But the most urgent task now is to restore light to the ancient world!
Just then,
Wen Zhong hurriedly walked up and said anxiously: "Your Majesty, now the Emperor of Heaven is covering the sky and threatening your Majesty. Originally, Empress Nuwa could have come forward in this matter, but now Empress Nuwa probably won't pay attention!"
Shang Rong also said anxiously: "Yes, Your Majesty, now is the critical time for eight hundred princes to meet Your Majesty, and there are countless rumors inside and outside Chaoge, all of which denounce Your Majesty's immorality. If we don't solve the problem of covering the sky, things will change soon!"
Bigan also said hurriedly: "Your Majesty, how about you appease the eight hundred princes first, and I and the Prime Minister will go out to quell the people's grievances?!"
